gloss: to knit, to braid, to weave

definitions.explanation: To create fabric by interlocking loops of yarn with needles.
To weave strands together into a pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}む。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手編|てあ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother made me a hand-knitted scarf.
I braid my hair into a three-strand plait.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{祖母|そぼ}はいつも{家族|かぞく}のために{手袋|てぶくろ}や{靴下|くつした}を{編|あ}んでくれた。
examples.english: When winter came, my grandmother always knitted gloves and socks for the family.

examples.japanese: {細|ほそ}いひもを{三|み}{本|ぼん}{束|たば}ねて{編|あ}んだ。
examples.english: I braided three thin cords together.

examples.japanese: {竹|たけ}を{細|ほそ}く{割|わ}って{丁寧|ていねい}に{編|あ}んでいくと、{美|うつく}しい{籠|かご}ができあがる。
examples.english: If you split bamboo into thin strips and carefully weave them together, you can make a beautiful basket.

notes:
{編|あ}む is used for creating fabric or patterns by interlocking or weaving strands.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: セーターを{編|あ}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手編|てあ}み: hand-knitted
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}み: three-strand braid
- {編|あ}み{物|もの}: knitting, knitted item
- {編|あ}み{針|ばり}: knitting needle

RELATED:
- {織|お}る: to weave (on a loom)
- {縫|ぬ}う: to sew
